content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Bakersfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma or equivalent) and completion of a specified number of project management education contact hours. Importantly, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for career changers and those new to project management across Bakersfield's energy, healthcare, construction, and public-sector employers.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format compresses the required project management education into a structured schedule, allowing you to learn foundational concepts, processes, and best practices from active certified practitioners without disrupting your current role.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure all documentation is complete and your candidacy is approved before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review core project management domains and practice exam-style questions. Schedule your proctored CAPM exam when you feel ready, and take it at a testing center convenient to your Bakersfield location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential current. CAPM renewal demonstrates your ongoing commitment to project management excellence and keeps you competitive in Bakersfield's dynamic job market.
